invariants — SHAPE2D descriptor op

• Data kinds: efdmodel → pairs

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.invariants(model, scale_invariant=True) (to call the implementation directly, import fourierdesc; fourierdesc.invariants(model, scale_invariant=True); from the registry, opsshape2d.get("invariants"))

Usage

Shape descriptor invariant to rotation, translation, starting point and (optionally) scale ((N,2)).

The (major axis, minor axis) of each harmonic's ellipse = its singular values, listed. It contains no DC, so it is invariant to translation; being singular values, it is invariant to spatial rotation and start-point shift; dividing by the major axis of the 1st harmonic makes it scale invariant. The foundation of shape matching (descriptor_distance).
